failure_modes.evidence: Cardiac events (bradycardia, AV block, extrasystoles) were more frequent in the 5.0 mg arm, which may have influenced the eventual regulatory approval of only the 0.5 mg dose in subsequent trials. However, within this trial, dosing was not truncated and both doses were maintained throughout the study. This is a weak caveat rather than a true DLT failure.
